question.problem:
$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}^{′}(t)={x}^{2}(t)+3y(t)-4x(t)+4 \\ {y}^{′}(t)={x}^{2}(t)-2x(t)+{y}^{2}(t)\end{aligned}
$$

Consider the system of differential equations above. What is the corresponding linearized system at the equilibrium point $\mathbf{x}^\ast=[2, \ 0]^T?$
question.worked_solution:
The system can be rewritten in matrix form as 

$$
\mathbf{x}' = \boldsymbol{f}(\mathbf{x})
$$

where ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14149202/assets/d422a2e5dc28d7f3163879aa16f212b3573e9f2eb20f6aa1dd28ce2e8b55466b.svg) and 
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14149202/assets/2df6f3b3a0c55d34c93291a33fca3f3f33f61a7491beb4cc495540a0f5ab5ae6.svg)

We need to compute the Jacobian matrix (or the total derivative) of $\boldsymbol{f}(\mathbf{x}).$ 

In our case, we have the following:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14149202/assets/a59de210f69e55b9de475da491dc1de9f32ccad7253ab1e4ab70714b96210e6d.svg)

First, we compute the partial derivatives:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂{f}_{1}}{∂x} & =\frac{∂}{∂x}({x}^{2}+3y-4x+4)=2x-4,\, & \frac{∂{f}_{1}}{∂y} & =\frac{∂}{∂y}({x}^{2}+3y-4x+4)=3 \\ \frac{∂{f}_{2}}{∂x} & =\frac{∂}{∂x}({x}^{2}-2x+{y}^{2})=2x-2,\, & \frac{∂{f}_{2}}{∂y} & =\frac{∂}{∂y}({x}^{2}-2x+{y}^{2})=2y\end{aligned}
$$

Thus, we have

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14149202/assets/2832518b9ff9a0795b8b1f337a92fbd97b8b1628da52ee88a2a9c88d95c330bc.svg)

Next, we evaluate the Jacobian at the equilibrium ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14149202/assets/0e9e15cf4c6eb8e07e42b3c32fffe458c230511e50e02650f8c9bf4226801b5a.svg) to get

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14149202/assets/cf167eaf02d0500310e31db9b3db546c3dcd1b395438bdf5daaeefec2af500ae.svg)

Finally, near the equilibrium, the nonlinear system is approximated by

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14149202/assets/39b57ee5a860cfd3b73c64bebf93a77a193339530ae6970f931972a2e345a1df.svg)

where the deviation vector is

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14149202/assets/3c80deae8395322a7abb6e106ccf084428b93e00e9b8087f53aa0c8bb76c00e4.svg)
